answer: The cedar lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the nectar is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nebula of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
